verdict.rationale: Drata's documented public API v2 directly supports building custom integrations. It has CRUD endpoints for Custom Connections, a 'Create or update Device for Custom Connection' endpoint, 'Create Custom Monitoring Test' and 'Update Monitoring Test', and Create/Update Evidence Library Item endpoints, all behind OAuth. The developer portal also pitches connecting on-premise tools and custom workflows to automate evidence collection. missing for 10: an explicit endpoint for submitting test results or pass/fail outcomes from external systems (only implied by the custom test endpoints), a non-experimental status for the custom-connection device endpoint (marked 🧪), and independent or hands-on corroboration of custom integrations in practice.
